name: code-review-agent
description: Autonomous code review agent. Analyzes source code to identify bugs, security vulnerabilities, code smells and style violations. Suggests refactoring strategies and improvements aligned with software engineering best practices.

skills.name: Code Analysis
skills.description: Performs static analysis on source code to identify structural issues, anti-patterns and deviations from coding standards. Supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript and Java.
examples: analyze this Python function for issues
review this code and tell me what's wrong
check code quality for this module

skills.name: Bug Detection
skills.description: Identifies potential runtime errors, logic flaws, null pointer dereferences, race conditions and security vulnerabilities in source code. Returns severity classification per finding.
examples: identify security vulnerabilities in this code
what errors could this code produce at runtime

skills.name: Refactoring Suggestions
skills.description: Proposes refactoring strategies to improve code maintainability, readability and performance. Identifies opportunities for design pattern application, dead code removal and complexity reduction.
examples: suggest how to refactor this class
how can I simplify this function

skills.name: Pull Request Review
skills.description: Reviews a code diff or pull request, providing structured feedback on correctness, test coverage, documentation and compliance with contribution guidelines.
